senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דחי)to push, thrust, knock down (interchanging with דָּחָה).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:6">Yoma VI, 6</cite> <he>דְּחָפוֹ וכ׳</he> knocked him down backward.

<cite ref="Yoma 66b:8">Ib. 66ᵇ</cite> <he>דחפו</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 4:14">Tosef. ib. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 3:14">III</cite>), 14 <he>דחאו</he>), v. <cite ref="D00406"><he>דחי</he></cite>.
Snh. VI, 4; a. e.—Part. pass. דָּחוּף, f. דְּחוּפָה impelled, hastened.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:5">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מיתה ד׳</he> (stronger than <he>דְּחוּיָה</he>, v. <cite ref="D00406"><he>דחי</he></cite>; Var. <he>סחופה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).
